meta.title: UAF Campus Map — Phase 1 Production Pilot
meta.status: public pilot — Phase 2A/3 complete; GIS upgrade hooks included
meta.launch_gate: This public pilot uses current public UAF building, parking, shuttle, trails, accessibility-resource, and 2026 construction information. Exact building footprints, parking polygons, entrances, and accessible route geometry remain future authoritative-GIS upgrades.

parking_policy.visitor_note: Kiosks sell day, week and month passes; Passport Parking can be used by visitors for hourly or daily parking.
parking_policy.accessible_note: A regular parking decal or permit is required in addition to an ADA permit for available ADA spaces. Zone 907 ADA parking also requires current pay-by-plate permit or meter payment when available.

contact.location: Signers' Hall, first floor, 1810 Salcha St.

shuttle.note: Use BusWhere for live vehicle location and the UAF Shuttle Bus page for current schedules.

routes.name: On-campus shuttle
routes.note: Use BusWhere for current route state, stops and ETAs.

accessibility.routing_status: Do not generate accessible turn-by-turn routes until authoritative UAF GIS/Facilities accessibility geometry is loaded.
accessibility.policy_note: UAF Facilities publishes a campus accessibility and gender-neutral facility map. The pilot links users to current UAF accessibility resources and does not infer turn-by-turn accessible routes.
